entry.title: BILL031(26) (Honolulu): PUBLISH → HHP
entry.content:
RELATING TO CULTURAL SITES IN PUBLIC PARKS.

Authorizes the DPR Director to establish a program to allow for improved stewardship of cultural sites in City parks. Establishes the process for including cultural sites in City parks in the program. Requires a stewardship plan. Provides the DPR Director with rulemaking authority. Imposes certain criminal penalties.

Status: PUBLISH → HHP

Latest action: CR-225(26) Reported out for passage on third reading as amended in CD2 form.
